decision.reason: More complete (14 routes vs 5), proper MVC structure, uses env vars for config, has merchant middleware, rate limiting, SQL guard, audit logging
decision.deprecationMethod: Root index.js becomes thin wrapper delegating to src/index.js
decision.packageJsonFix: Already correct: "start": "node src/index.js". Add dev script.

routeMapping.note: Frontend client-v2/src/api/index.js uses BASE='/api'. Server mounts all routes under /api via src/index.js. Compatible.

jwtConfig.currentIssue: Root middleware/auth.js hardcodes SECRET='<EXAMPLE_JWT_SECRET_PLACEHOLDER>' while .env has JWT_SECRET=ecommerce_jwt_2024_secret
jwtConfig.fix: src/middleware/auth.js already uses process.env.JWT_SECRET. No code change needed for src/. Root auth.js will be deprecated.
jwtConfig.verification: Both src/index.js (require('dotenv')) and src/middleware/auth.js (process.env.JWT_SECRET) are consistent.
